VsCodeTaskButtons.tasks.label: $(rocket) Deploy game
VsCodeTaskButtons.tasks.tooltip: npm run deploy -- the live player-facing app

VsCodeTaskButtons.tasks.label: $(plug) MCP
VsCodeTaskButtons.tasks.tooltip: Get MCP clients onto current code: restart local stdio servers, or deploy the hosted Worker

tasks.label: Restart stdio MCP
tasks.description: $(debug-restart) Stop this checkout's mcp-server.mjs processes; each host reconnects to current code

tasks.label: Deploy hosted MCP
tasks.description: $(cloud-upload) npm run mcp:hosted:deploy — the Cloudflare-hosted authoring Worker

tasks.label: Release hosted MCP
tasks.description: $(database) npm run mcp:hosted:release — apply remote D1 migrations, then deploy

VsCodeTaskButtons.tasks.label: $(server) Deploy Authoring
VsCodeTaskButtons.tasks.tooltip: npm run authoring:deploy — refuses to restart on a branch that does not include origin/main

tasks.label: Redeploy current branch
tasks.description: $(sync) Pull the branch the server is on and restart

VsCodeTaskButtons.tasks.label: $(flame) Monster Mash
VsCodeTaskButtons.tasks.tooltip: npm run test:all -- everything, including the slow layout-quality searches (~15 min)

VsCodeTaskButtons.tasks.label: $(graph) Content stats
VsCodeTaskButtons.tasks.tooltip: npm run content:stats -- which schema features are actually used across the puzzle collection

tasks.label: Open in browser
tasks.description: $(link-external) Start the server in the background if needed, then open the Library

tasks.label: Run dev server in terminal
tasks.description: $(terminal) npm run dev — logs in a terminal panel, no browser (Worker mode: npm run dev -- --worker)

tasks.label: Stop dev server
tasks.description: $(debug-stop) npm run dev:stop — however it was started

VsCodeTaskButtons.tasks.label: $(cloud-download) Import layout
VsCodeTaskButtons.tasks.tooltip: npm run import:star-layout -- pick a layout JSON exported from Author Layout and save it as a curated Star override
